title: A Survey on Recognizing Textual Entailment as an NLP Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: The paper surveys prior literature (e.g., Rudinger et al., 2017) that evaluates how eliciting hypotheses from crowd-workers creates stereotypical gender associations in the SNLI dataset.
The paper surveys prior literature that identifies age-based stereotypes introduced during the dataset creation and crowd-sourcing processes of Natural Language Inference datasets.
The paper reviews literature demonstrating that racial stereotypes and biases are embedded into the textual entailment examples generated by crowd-source workers.
The paper reviews methodologies using hypothesis-only models to evaluate and expose unintended linguistic artifacts and heuristic biases within large-scale NLI datasets.
